capture.intro: Photograph the whole receipt on a flat surface, in good light.
capture.privacy: The photo is reduced on this device, read once and then deleted. Nothing about it is kept.

problem.notImage: This file is not a photo. Choose a photo of the receipt.
problem.unreadablePhoto: This photo could not be opened. Try another one.
problem.offline: No connection. Scanning needs the internet, so try again when you are back online.
problem.quota: AI limit reached for this month. You can still add the expense by hand.
problem.unavailable: Scanning is not available right now.
problem.unreadable: We could not read this receipt, try a clearer photo.
problem.throttled: Too many scans in a minute. Wait a moment and try again.
problem.upload: The photo could not be uploaded. Try again.

review.title: Review receipt

discardSheet.title: Discard this receipt?
discardSheet.body: The details read from the photo will be lost. Nothing has been saved.

confidence.high: Read clearly. Check the details before saving.
confidence.medium: Some parts were hard to read. Check the amount and the date.
confidence.low: Hard to read. Check every field before saving.

review.splitHint: Give each line of the receipt its own category.
review.difference: The last line takes {amount} so the lines match the total.

issue.tooFewLines: A split needs at least two lines. Turn off split by lines to save it with one category.
issue.zeroLine: A line has no amount left. Merge it with another line or drop it.
issue.overTotal: The lines add up to more than the total.
issue.tooManyLines: Too many lines for one split. Merge some of them.

review.selected: {count, plural, one {# line selected} other {# lines selected}}
review.offline: No connection. The receipt is still here, so save it again when you are back online.
review.loadError: Your accounts could not be loaded.
